definitions.explanation: Refers to something that has already been mentioned or discussed earlier in a text or speech. A formal, written-style expression commonly used in academic papers, reports, and official documents.

examples.japanese: {前述|ぜんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
{前述|ぜんじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: We will examine the issue mentioned earlier.

examples.japanese: {前述|ぜんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: For the aforementioned reasons, we decided to cancel this plan.

notes:
A formal, written-style word. Rarely used in casual conversation. Typically found in essays, reports, academic papers, and official documents.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前述|ぜんじゅつ} — aforementioned (formal, written)
- ⟦{上記|じょうき}→上記：11375_jouki⟧ — above-mentioned (more common in documents with visual layout)
- {先述|せんじゅつ} — previously stated (synonym, slightly less common)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {前述|ぜんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (the aforementioned ~)
- {前述|ぜんじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とおり (as mentioned above)
- {前述|ぜんじゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧〜 (the previously stated ~)
